verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a self-serve trial with no credit card (close-docs-32) and pipeline management as a feature (close-docs-34). Getting real data in is documented only through the REST API (close-docs-1), which is a developer building block, not a guided import or migration flow. Nothing documents CSV or CRM import tooling, onboarding time-to-value, or setup without an implementation partner, so the story's actual capability is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a founder, I can go from signup to a working pipeline with my real data in under an hour, without an implementation partner
